title: dspy
summary: DSPy is a framework for algorithmically optimizing Language Model (LM) prompts and weights, enabling developers to build complex, robust, and efficient LM-powered applications. It allows users to programmatically compose LM calls, manage data flow, and automatically tune prompts and models using various optimization techniques. This repository provides the core primitives, client integrations, program development tools, and data/evaluation utilities necessary to build and refine advanced LLM systems.

nodes.label: Developer / User
nodes.title: DSPy Developer
nodes.description: The human user or developer who designs, implements, and optimizes DSPy programs to solve complex tasks using large language models.

nodes.label: Define DSPy Programs
nodes.title: Core Program Definition
nodes.description: Provides the foundational building blocks for DSPy programs, including modules, signatures, and utilities for structuring LLM interactions and program logic.

nodes.label: Execute & Stream Programs
nodes.title: Program Execution & Streaming
nodes.description: Manages the execution flow of DSPy programs, including asynchronous operations, streaming outputs, and serialization for interactive development and deployment.

nodes.label: Manage LM Clients & Calls
nodes.title: LM Client Management
nodes.description: Handles connections to various Language Models, provides caching mechanisms, and manages the lifecycle of LM calls for text completion and embedding generation.

nodes.label: External Language Models
nodes.title: External LLM Providers
nodes.description: Represents the actual large language models (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, local models) that DSPy interacts with for text generation and understanding.

nodes.label: Optimize DSPy Programs
nodes.title: Program Optimization
nodes.description: Contains advanced predictors, program analysis tools, and teleprompters for automated prompt engineering, few-shot example selection, and model fine-tuning to enhance program performance.

nodes.label: Manage Datasets
nodes.title: Dataset Management
nodes.description: Provides utilities for loading, structuring, and splitting various datasets from diverse sources, converting them into DSPy Example objects for training and evaluation.

nodes.label: Evaluate Program Performance
nodes.title: Program Evaluation
nodes.description: Offers a comprehensive collection of metrics, including LLM-based auto-evaluation and traditional string-based comparisons, to assess the quality and effectiveness of DSPy programs.

nodes.label: Adapt Data Types & Systems
nodes.title: Data & System Adapters
nodes.description: Equips DSPy programs to handle diverse data types (e.g., images, audio, code) and manage complex interactions with language models, including prompt formatting and output parsing.

nodes.label: Retrieve External Knowledge
nodes.title: Information Retrieval
nodes.description: Provides various retrieval mechanisms (e.g., ColBERTv2, Databricks Vector Search) to efficiently fetch relevant passages or documents from knowledge bases to provide context for LLMs.

nodes.label: External Knowledge Bases
nodes.title: External Knowledge Sources
nodes.description: Represents external data stores, vector databases, or search indexes (e.g., Weaviate, Databricks Vector Search) that DSPy programs query for contextual information.

groups.label: Core Program Definition & Execution
groups.title: Core Program Definition & Execution
groups.description: This group encompasses how users define the structure and logic of their DSPy programs, including modules, signatures, and the mechanisms for executing and streaming program outputs.

groups.label: Language Model Interaction
groups.title: Language Model Interaction
groups.description: This group manages all aspects of interacting with large language models, from abstracting different providers and handling API calls to implementing caching and specific LM integrations.

groups.label: Program Optimization & Evaluation
groups.title: Program Optimization & Evaluation
groups.description: This group provides the tools and techniques for refining and improving DSPy programs, including advanced predictors, automated prompt engineering (teleprompters), and comprehensive evaluation metrics.

groups.label: External Data & Tool Integration
groups.title: External Data & Tool Integration
groups.description: This group focuses on enabling DSPy programs to interact with external systems, handling diverse data types, adapting system interactions, and retrieving information from external knowledge bases.
